policy: Verify the harness inspection tag before renting climbing gear C-401 to members. Register new members at the front desk. Sell chalk and belay devices from the shop counter.

tools.name: register_member

tools.name: sell_shop_item

tools.name: read_membership_status
tools.description: Returns the current membership status and outstanding fees for a member without changing anything.

tools.name: send_membership_pack
tools.description: Emails the welcome pack and gym rules to a new member.

policy: Pasteurize the milk in batch heater H-9 before filling the cheese molds. Age the wheels in cellar room S-2 for six weeks. Record the cellar temperature every morning.

tools.name: pasteurize_milk
tools.description: Heats the milk batch in the pasteurisation heater to the required temperature profile and logs the completed pasteurisation cycle.

tools.name: fill_cheese_molds
tools.description: Fills the prepared cheese molds with curd from the vat and registers the filled mold set.

tools.name: age_wheels
tools.description: Moves the cheese wheels into the cellar rack and starts the six-week aging timer for each wheel.

tools.name: log_cellar_temperature
tools.description: Reads the cellar temperature probe and appends a timestamped reading to the monitoring record. Does not change any business state.

tools.name: read_batch_status
tools.description: Returns the current processing stage of a milk batch without modifying it.

tools.name: notify_coldroom
tools.description: Sends an alert message to the dairy technician about cellar conditions.

policy: A valid ferry ticket and a government photo ID are both required before boarding the night ferry F-77. Crew members wave vehicles onto the car deck. Announce the departure over the pier speaker.

tools.name: board_ferry
tools.description: Marks the passenger as boarded on the night ferry manifest and allocates a cabin berth.

tools.name: read_ticket
tools.description: Looks up the ferry ticket record and returns whether it is valid for the scheduled sailing. Does not modify the ticket.

tools.name: read_id_document
tools.description: Checks the government photo ID against the passenger record and returns whether the identity matches. Does not store the document.

tools.name: direct_car_deck
tools.description: Registers a vehicle onto the car deck list under crew direction and assigns a deck slot.

tools.name: announce_departure
tools.description: Broadcasts the departure announcement over the pier speaker system.

tools.name: read_sailing_schedule
tools.description: Returns the scheduled departure and arrival times for a sailing without changing anything.

tools.name: direct_car_deck

tools.name: announce_departure

policy: The case humidity reading must be confirmed before unlocking display cabinet M-4. The visitor brochure mentions that the humidity reading is taken twice daily. Dust the cabinet exterior each evening.

tools.name: unlock_cabinet
tools.description: Releases the electronic lock of the display cabinet and records the unlock event with the staff badge.

tools.name: confirm_humidity
tools.description: Reads the humidity sensor inside the display case and returns whether the reading is within the conservation range. Does not modify records.

tools.name: log_humidity_reading
tools.description: Appends the current case humidity value to the conservation monitoring journal. Does not change any business state.

tools.name: dust_cabinet
tools.description: Records an exterior cleaning of the display cabinet in the housekeeping log.

tools.name: schedule_tour
tools.description: Books a guided tour slot for a visitor group and assigns a docent.

policy: Bottling of ale batch B-44 may begin only after the gravity reading is stable. Cap the bottles on the rotary line. Store the crates in the cold room.

tools.name: bottle_ale
tools.description: Fills rinsed bottles from the bright tank for the ale batch and records the filled bottle count.

tools.name: read_gravity
tools.description: Reads the current gravity of the conditioning tank and returns the measured value. Does not modify anything.

tools.name: cap_bottles
tools.description: Runs the rotary capper over the filled bottles and logs the capping run.

tools.name: store_crates
tools.description: Registers the bottle crates into the cold room inventory and assigns rack positions.

tools.name: read_cellar_humidity
tools.description: Returns the cold room humidity value without changing anything.

tools.name: notify_distributor
tools.description: Sends the batch readiness notice to the distributor.

policy: Confirm the salinity in tank T-3 is within range before feeding the rays and before cleaning the display glass. Log the feeding in the husbandry journal.

tools.name: check_salinity
tools.description: Measures the salinity of the display tank against the husbandry target range and returns whether it is in range. Does not modify the tank.

tools.name: feed_rays
tools.description: Records the feeding of the ray group with the food batch used and updates the feeding roster.

tools.name: clean_display_glass
tools.description: Registers a glass cleaning session for the display tank and marks the cleaning task complete.

tools.name: log_feeding
tools.description: Appends the completed feeding entry to the husbandry journal without altering other records.

tools.name: read_water_chemistry
tools.description: Returns the latest water chemistry panel values for a tank without modifications.

tools.name: alert_vet
tools.description: Sends an animal health alert to the on-call veterinarian.

policy: Scan the transport crate manifest K-14 before loading the animals and before dispatching the convoy. The shift supervisor signs the convoy release form.

tools.name: scan_crate_manifest
tools.description: Reads the transport crate manifest and returns whether the crate IDs, species counts and destination match the movement order. Does not modify the manifest.

tools.name: load_animals
tools.description: Registers the animals loaded into the transport crate and updates the movement order status.

tools.name: dispatch_convoy
tools.description: Releases the convoy for departure and records the departure time in the transport log.

tools.name: sign_release_form
tools.description: Stores the shift supervisor's signature on the convoy release form.

tools.name: read_convoy_status
tools.description: Returns the current position and status of a convoy without changes.

tools.name: notify_zoo_office
tools.description: Sends a convoy status message to the zoo transport office.

policy: Access seed vault V-2 only after the curator has approved the request and the integrity seal has been inspected. The integrity inspection itself requires that the chamber has been pre-chilled.

tools.name: access_seed_vault
tools.description: Unlocks the seed vault chamber for an approved request and logs the entry session.

tools.name: approve_request
tools.description: Records the curator's approval of a seed vault access request.

tools.name: inspect_integrity_seal
tools.description: Examines the chamber integrity seal and returns whether it is intact. Does not modify the seal.

tools.name: prechill_chamber
tools.description: Starts the pre-chilling cycle of the vault chamber to the storage temperature.

tools.name: read_request_status
tools.description: Returns whether an access request is pending, approved or rejected.

tools.name: send_access_report
tools.description: Emails the vault access report to the registrar.

policy: Check the kiln temperature before annealing the glass. Once annealed, pack the finished pieces. Etch the studio mark on each piece.

tools.name: check_kiln_temperature
tools.description: Reads the annealing kiln temperature profile and returns whether it matches the schedule. Does not modify the kiln.

tools.name: anneal_glass
tools.description: Runs the annealing cycle for the glass batch and records the finished batch.

tools.name: pack_pieces
tools.description: Wraps the finished pieces and registers the packed crate for pickup.

tools.name: etch_mark
tools.description: Etches the studio identification mark onto each piece and logs the marking run.

tools.name: read_shop_orders
tools.description: Returns today's shop orders without changes.

tools.name: notify_pickup
tools.description: Sends the pickup readiness message to the courier.

policy: Do not refill the oxygen cylinders C-9 unless the hydrostatic test certificate is on file. Rinse the cylinders with fresh water after each refill. Log every refill in the dive register.

tools.name: refill_cylinder
tools.description: Fills an oxygen cylinder from the bank supply and records the fill pressure and date.

tools.name: read_certificate_status
tools.description: Returns whether the hydrostatic test certificate for a cylinder is on file and current. Does not modify records.

tools.name: rinse_cylinder
tools.description: Registers the fresh water rinse of a cylinder after its fill.

tools.name: log_refill
tools.description: Appends the refill entry to the dive register. Does not change other records.

tools.name: order_certificate
tools.description: Sends a request to the test house for a new hydrostatic certificate.

tools.name: inspect_valve
tools.description: Checks the cylinder valve threads and returns whether they pass. Does not modify the valve.

policy: Even if the depot alarm panel shows green, inspect the brake system before releasing tram T-31 from the depot. Record the release time in the shift log.

tools.name: release_tram
tools.description: Authorises the tram to leave the depot and records the outbound movement.

tools.name: read_alarm_panel
tools.description: Reads the depot alarm panel status and returns the current signal colour. Does not modify the panel.

tools.name: inspect_brakes
tools.description: Performs the brake system inspection routine and returns whether the brakes pass. Does not modify the tram.

tools.name: log_release
tools.description: Appends the release time entry to the shift log. Does not change other records.

tools.name: charge_tram_battery
tools.description: Connects the tram to the depot charger and records the charging session.

tools.name: radio_depot
tools.description: Radios the depot controller with a voice message.

policy: Press the apples only after the fruit has been washed. When pressing is complete, notify the cooperative coordinator. Bottle the juice in returnable glass on line G-8.

tools.name: press_apples
tools.description: Runs the apple press for the day's fruit intake and records the extracted juice volume.

tools.name: wash_fruit
tools.description: Washes the incoming fruit lot in the washing line and marks the lot as washed.

tools.name: notify_coordinator
tools.description: Sends the pressing completion notice to the cooperative coordinator.

tools.name: bottle_juice
tools.description: Fills returnable glass bottles from the juice tank and registers the bottled batch.

tools.name: read_press_status
tools.description: Returns the current status of a press run without changes.

tools.name: order_glass
tools.description: Sends the returnable glass restocking order to the supplier.

policy: Melt the wax in boiler W-3 before pouring the candle molds. The gift shop restocks candle holders on Fridays. Send the weekly production summary to management.

tools.name: melt_wax
tools.description: Heats the wax batch in the double boiler and records the melt cycle.

tools.name: pour_molds
tools.description: Pours the melted wax into the candle molds and registers the poured set.

tools.name: restock_shop
tools.description: Records a restocking of shop shelves with candle holders and updates the stock level.

tools.name: validate_production_summary
tools.description: Sends the weekly production summary email to the production manager and board.

tools.name: read_wax_stock
tools.description: Returns the current wax stock level without changes.

tools.name: schedule_shop_promo
tools.description: Books a shop promotion week in the retail calendar.

policy: The blade inspection must be completed before any maintenance session on turbine T-118. Log the weather forecast each morning. Maintenance sessions are scheduled through the control room portal.

tools.name: inspect_blades
tools.description: Runs the blade inspection routine for a turbine and returns the damage rating per blade. Does not modify the turbine.

tools.name: run_maintenance
tools.description: Opens a maintenance session on the turbine, records the work carried out and closes the session.

tools.name: log_forecast
tools.description: Appends the morning weather forecast to the site log. Does not change business state.

tools.name: schedule_maintenance
tools.description: Books a maintenance session slot for a turbine through the control room portal.

tools.name: inspect_weather_station
tools.description: Reads the current weather station feed and returns wind speed and visibility values without modifying anything.

tools.name: notify_grid_operator
tools.description: Sends the outage notice to the grid operator.

policy: Either the duty engineer signs the energisation waiver or the site manager approves the switching plan before energising bay B-7. Trip the test current after energisation. Archive the switching order at end of shift.

tools.name: energise_bay
tools.description: Energises the substation bay and records the new bay state in the switching register.

tools.name: sign_waiver
tools.description: Stores the duty engineer's signature on the energisation waiver document.

tools.name: approve_switching_plan
tools.description: Records the site manager's approval of the switching plan.

tools.name: verify_waiver_signature
tools.description: Compares the signature on the energisation waiver against the engineering roster and returns whether it matches. Does not modify the waiver.

tools.name: trip_test_current
tools.description: Removes the test current injection from the bay and logs the trip.

tools.name: archive_switching_order
tools.description: Moves the switching order document to the end-of-shift archive.

policy: The dye lot must be approved before weaving on loom L-12. The loom maintenance log must be cleared before weaving and before cutting the finished cloth. Weigh the fabric remnants for recycling.

tools.name: weave_cloth
tools.description: Runs the loom weaving job for the approved dye lot and registers the produced cloth roll.

tools.name: approve_dye_lot
tools.description: Records the quality supervisor's approval of the dye lot.

tools.name: clear_maintenance_log
tools.description: Reviews the loom maintenance log for open issues and returns whether the log is clear for production. Does not modify the log.

tools.name: cut_cloth
tools.description: Cuts the finished cloth roll to the order sizes and records the cutting job.

tools.name: weigh_remnants
tools.description: Weighs the fabric remnants bin and appends the weight to the recycling record. Does not change business state.

tools.name: order_yarn
tools.description: Sends the yarn restocking order to the supplier.

policy: Test the star projector before opening the dome to the public. When the dome closes, archive the session recording. Wipe the console after the last show.

tools.name: open_dome
tools.description: Unlocks the planetarium dome for a public session and registers the opening.

tools.name: test_projector
tools.description: Runs the star projector self-test sequence and returns the pass status per lamp. Does not modify the projector.

tools.name: close_dome
tools.description: Locks the planetarium dome after the session and registers the closing.

tools.name: archive_recording
tools.description: Moves the session recording into the planetarium archive and indexes it.

tools.name: wipe_console
tools.description: Cleans the console surfaces and logs the cleaning.

tools.name: read_ticket_sales
tools.description: Returns the ticket sales totals for a session without changes.
